attorneys.name: James L. Miller
attorneys.practice_type: Bankruptcy Law Lawyers in Milwaukee, WI
attorneys.bio:
As both the founder of Miller & Miller and from a personal standpoint, Jamie knows how devastating financial issues can be to an individual and their family. While Jamie was an undergraduate at University of Wisconsin in Madison, his own parents were forced into bankruptcy due to a series of health issues and business setbacks.

During this period, Jamie and his sibling helped their parents navigate the complex paperwork, court system and the emotional toll that were part of their bankruptcy process. While the bankruptcy was difficult for Jamie and his family, there was a bit of a “personal silver lining”. The experience convinced him to attend University of Miami and pursues a legal degree focusing on bankruptcy and financial matters.

Pairing over 20 years experience in bankruptcy and debt relief with a compassionate understanding of an individual’s feelings when faced with overwhelming debt, Jamie and his staff help individuals from all walks of life. By developing an understanding of each individual’s personal situation, Jamie helps clients find the best solution for their problems.

Bankruptcy isn’t right for everyone and in some cases, Jamie may recommend another route to financial freedom. Whether discussing Chapter 7, financial planning or credit restoration, Jamie has a sincere interest in his client’s problems and desire to help those in need.

Having started his firm in an empty room with nothing but a phone and legal pad, Jamie and his staff now have offices in Downtown Milwaukee, Brookfield, Kenosha and Madison. At Miller & Miller, the focus is on providing assistance to those battling financial problems and providing sound, financial strategies for individuals and companies across Southeastern Wisconsin. This dedication has enabled Miller & Miller to become one of the state’s most respected and successful law firms dealing with bankruptcy and financial matters.

Outside of his legal practice, Jamie volunteers with a number of charitable groups such as Operation Dream and the Milwaukee Jewish Community Center, plays in a local basketball league and runs the occasional marathon.

Giving Back

Attorney Miller and his staff are also committed to preserving justice and strengthening community in both their professional and personal lives.

Jamie has served as Board Chair at the Jewish Community Center (JCC) in Milwaukee. The JCC is an organization that celebrates Jewish life and values while providing for the community as a whole with diversified social, educational, recreational, and cultural programming.

Attorney James Miller is also a strong supporter of Operation Dream, which stands for Discipline, Respect, Education and Appreciation through Mentoring. This non-profit organization provides developmental opportunities and mentoring for over 250 boys and young men who are primarily of color and need positive role models in Milwaukee. It organizes and facilitates Saturday enrichment activities, tutoring support through academic collaboration, workforce development training, athletic opportunities, and summer programs.

Additionally, Attorney James Miller is the former President of Milwaukee Jewish Free Loan Association (mjfla.org), and is a current loan committee Chair. MJFLA provides interest-free loans to those with temporary financial needs, promoting self-sufficiency, dignity, and a “hand-up instead of a handout”. All loans are confidential and given on a non-sectarian basis to those who meet established criteria but are unable to obtain conventional loans. Because all loans are repaid, MJFLA recycles those funds into new loans for other individuals.

attorneys.name: Steve Miller
attorneys.practice_type: Appeals Lawyers in Hudson, WI
attorneys.bio: Steve began writing appeals in 1985 as a student intern with the Wisconsin Attorney General's Office, Criminal Appeals Division. From 1987 until 1994 he maintained a civil and criminal litigation practice with a heavy emphasis on appeals. Since 1996 his practice has been exclusively appellate. He has argued appeals in virtually every subject matter both civil and criminal. Steve is also certified with the Wisconsin State Public defender in Levels 1, 2 and 3 (all criminal cases including 1st degree homicide), and has been at one time or another certified for Chapters 48 and 938 (Juvenile); Chapters 51 & 55 (Mental Health, Guardianship & Protective Placement); and Termination of Parental Rights. He was also on the Board for the Appellate Practice Section of the State Bar of Wisconsin for five years. Steve offers his appellate services state-wide to both clients and trial lawyers. For clients he provides unmatched personal service. For lawyers his services are flexible to meet their precise needs including direct referrals, assistance and advice, or co-authorship.

attorneys.name: Geoff Misfeldt
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Milwaukee, WI
attorneys.bio:
Geoff Misfeldt joined Kohler & Hart, SC as an associate in 2010. His practice largely consists of criminal trial and appellate work in State and Federal courts. In addition to his criminal law practice, Geoff represents clients in personal injury cases and in licensing matters. Geoff has handled licensing matters for a variety of professions and occupations, including professionals in law, nursing, and the medical field, along with daycare and tavern licensures.Geoff takes a special interest in defending those accused of OWI offenses and subscribes to the firm's philosophy that you can only receive the best defense from someone who stays on top of the constantly changing legal and scientific landscape.Geoff has defended a number of firearms rights cases and, as a lifelong hunter, recognizes that the right to responsibly keep and bear arms is of special importance to many. He and Craig Powell vigorously fought against a law that prohibits all felons from forever possessing firearms, and they successfully challenged Wisconsin's law that prohibits people from openly carrying tasers.

Geoff has also been instrumental in helping many of the firm's clients obtain dismissals before trial in a variety of criminal cases. He challenged the constitutionality of a boating law that resulted in the dismissal of the case; helped a client charged with possessing more than a quarter-pound of marijuana obtain a non-jail sentence by challenging a drug dog's search of a home; and got a client's case dismissed when the prosecution withheld evidence.

Geoff has also obtained favorable results for appellate clients and has written briefs in cases before the Wisconsin Court of Appeals and the Wisconsin Supreme Court. He has assisted in the preparation of petitions to the United States Supreme Court and has also argued before the Wisconsin Supreme Court.

Prior to joining the firm, Geoff spent a year with the Milwaukee Office of the State Public Defender. While in law school, he co-founded the Marquette Law School Criminal Law Society, served as an intern to Chief Justice Shirley Abrahamson of the Wisconsin Supreme Court, and worked with the Federal Defender's Office in Milwaukee. Geoff obtained his B.S. from the University of Wisconsin-Eau Claire.

He is a member of the Wisconsin Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, the Milwaukee Bar Association, the Wisconsin State Bar, and is licensed to practice in Wisconsin's State and Federal Courts.

attorneys.name: Miss Richard S. Missimer
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Afton, WI
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Richard S. Missimer practices mostly divorce and family law. This includes property division, custody/placement issues, child support, domestic abuse/TROs and all other matters regarding the family. He also handles DUI/OWI cases, in which he uses his technical expertise to challenge breath and blood tests.

Richard originally came to Wisconsin to study engineering. In 1996, he earned a Bachelor of Science from UW-Madison in Computer Science. Has also earned a Masters of Science in Engineering, as well as a Bachelor of Science in Business, from Milwaukee School of Engineering (MSOE). For more than a decade, Richard has worked for various corporations as an engineering consultant. Richard has been a registered professional engineer (registration #34,808) in Wisconsin since May 2001.

Richard graduated from Marquette University Law School in 2006. His practice focuses on family law, business law, and all aspects of intellectual property law (including patents, copyrights, trademarks, and trade secrets). Richard has been a patent agent (registration #45,537), licensed to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office, since March 2000.

Richard has owned and operated several businesses. He has worked for large employers in supervisory and management roles, being responsible for processes, rules, accounting, and tax reporting, as well as contract negotiations. His experience spans over a 20-year period and aids in his practice of family law and divorce because business, negotiation, and tax reporting are a significant part of divorce and property division, especially when self-employed individuals or privately held companies are involved. Further, the logicial thought processes and problem-solving skills used in engineering work well in tough, highly emotional circumstances like divorce and family law. Richard is registered with the Eastern District of Wisconsin allowing him to practice bankruptcy law as it applies to his divorce cases.

How this all applies to his practice of law is that he has logical thinking, a great love for investigation and problems solving, mathematical and accounting expertise, and lastly does not give in when the client interests are at stake.

attorneys.name: Miss Karyn T. Missimer
attorneys.practice_type: DUI Defense Lawyers in Afton, WI
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Karyn T. Missimer is regarded by her colleagues and judges as thorough and detail-oriented. Karyn graduated from Marquette University Law School in 2006, where she received the highest class grade in Legal Research and Writing. She also earned the distinction of being the only first-year law student to ever argue onto Moot Court. Further, she received the Pro Bono Society Honor for dedicating over 60 hours of her time to nonprofit legal organizations.

Karyn's practice focuses on criminal defense and family law at both the trial and appellate levels. She has been a member of the Wisconsin Association of Criminal Defense Attorneys since 2006 and a member of the National College for DUI Defense ("NCDD") since 2007.

DUI Defense Experience: For years, Karyn's criminal defense practice has focused almost exclusively on DUI defense. In 2007 and 2009, she attended the NCDD's annual Mastering Scientific Evidence seminar, thereby sharpening her ability to challenge breath and blood tests. In 2007 and 2008, she attended the NCDD's annual Summer Sessions in Boston, Massachusetts. The Summer Sessions cover all aspects of jury trial work, including, persuasion techniques, directing and cross-examining expert witnesses, and effectively challenging field sobriety tests. Karyn has had numerous DUI trials and is very well-versed in this area of law.

Criminal Law Experience: Before law school, Karyn worked as a criminal law paralegal for six years. In law school, she interned with the Milwaukee Trial Division of the Wisconsin State Public Defender's Office. During that time, she represented indigent clients in all aspects of misdemeanor and felony matters. Criminal defense has been a major part of Karyn's practice since 2006.

Appellate Experience: Karyn interned for the Honorable Harry G. Snyder at the Wisconsin Court of Appeals District II. There, she researched criminal appellate matters, including eye witness identification issues and Fourth Amendment violations. Karyn has drafted appeals submitted to the Wisconsin Court of Appeals, as well as the Seventh and Eighth Circuits.

Family Law Experience: Before law school, Karyn worked as a family law paralegal for two years. During law school, she interned for Centro Legal and assisted in the representation of indigent family law clients at paternity hearings, child support hearings, and custody/placement disputes. Karyn handles both highly-contested and cordial family law matters.

attorneys.name: Tiffany Mitchell
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Milwaukee, WI
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Tiffany Mitchell represents whistleblowers in cases involving fraud, retaliation, and corporate or government misconduct. As a former investigative and intelligence analyst across state and federal agencies, the financial sector, and the military, Attorney Mitchell brings over a decade of experience in fraud prevention, regulatory compliance, and complex investigations to Cross Law Firm, S.C.

In addition, Attorney Mitchell handles employment and business litigation, including cases involving wage theft, misclassification and discrimination. She reviews and negotiates employment contracts, severance agreements, restrictive covenants, non-compete and non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), with a focus on healthcare professionals, executives, and commission-based roles. She also assists clients with partnership and small business formation, business disputes, and works in the CLF In-House Counsel Program to counsel business start-ups and small businesses.

Attorney Mitchell earned her J.D. from the University of Wisconsin Law School. She also holds a Master of Public Administration and a Bachelor of Arts from Drake University.

Outside of work, she values time with family, staying active, getting lost in a good book, and volunteering to support fellow veterans.

attorneys.name: Abby Moe
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Madison, WI
attorneys.bio:
Abby Moe is an Associate at Nicholson Goetz & Otis, S.C., where she focuses her practice on family law and injunction matters, including restraining orders. She is a graduate of the University of Wisconsin Law School and brings a unique blend of legal skill, analytical strength, and compassion to every case.

Before becoming an attorney, Ms. Moe worked as a parent educator and birth doula, giving her a strong foundation in family systems and child development. This background allows her to approach divorce, paternity, custody, and placement matters with a deep understanding of the personal dynamics families face.

Attorney Moe also has a strong background in mathematics, which she applies to the financial aspects of family law. She assists clients with marital balance sheets, asset division, maintenance and maintenance buyout calculations, and child support calculations to ensure clarity and accuracy throughout the process.

She represents clients in mediations, settlements, contested hearings, and trials involving a wide range of family law issues, including custody, property division, school enrollment disputes, and marital property agreements. She is committed to client-centered, collaborative representation paired with vigorous advocacy.

Outside the office, Attorney Moe enjoys spending time with her children, staying active at the gym, and getting outdoors through activities such as biking, snowboarding, and paddleboarding.

attorneys.name: Corey Montiho
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Brookfield, WI
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Montiho is a native of Waukesha, a 2000 graduate of The Citadel, The Military College of South Carolina, and 2003 graduate of the University of Wisconsin Law School.

At the Citadel Montiho was awarded the Dean’s List Medal, elected to the Honor Court, was an elected class representative, was an active member of Pi Sigma Alpha-The National Political Science Honor Society, and held numerous positions of cadet leadership. He also served as an intern at The White House in the Office of the Vice President.

While at The University of Wisconsin Law School he was a Judicial Intern for Chief Justice Shirley Abrahamson, served as a law clerk for Madison’s City Attorney, and served as law clerk in private practice in Madison, Wisconsin.

Attorney Montiho has expertly represented clients in all aspects of Family Law for more than eighteen years. His experience and wide-ranging knowledge are an invaluable asset to his clients.

Attorney Montiho is an elected member of the Board of Education for the School District of Waukesha and was elected to the Waukesha County Bar Association Board of Directors and the Board of Directors for the Housing Action Coalition of Waukesha County.

Attorney Montiho also serves on the City of Waukesha’s Plan Commission and a is former member of the Board of Zoning Appeals, both by appointment of Mayor Shawn Reilly, and was Co-President of Summit View Elementary’s Parent Teacher Organization. He is also a member of the Wisconsin Chapter of the Association of Family and Conciliation Corps and the Collaborative Family Law Council of Wisconsin.

attorneys.name: Nicole A. Muller
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Milwaukee, WI
attorneys.bio:
Nicole A. Muller is an attorney with Birdsall Muller LLC law firm in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Having quickly established herself as among the top trial attorneys in her region, Attorney Muller provides exceptional counsel and support to clients throughout the greater Milwaukee metro area and all across the state who stand accused or are under investigation for any type of felony or misdemeanor criminal offense.

As a criminal defense attorney, Attorney Muller has an abiding passion for protecting the rights and liberties of the accused, and she has a particular concern for addressing racial discrepancies and the other issues that plague her area's criminal justice system. As such, she has become a champion for Milwaukee's urban poor and other marginalized members of her community, and she has achieved remarkable success advocating on behalf of those who may otherwise receive unfair treatment during all stages of the criminal justice process.

A 2014 graduate of The Catholic University of America, Attorney Muller received her master's degree in 2015 from Columbia University. She then relocated from her native New York to Wisconsin, where she attended Marquette University Law School. She obtained her Juris Doctor in 2018, and she is admitted to practice before all Wisconsin state courts as well as before the U.S. District Courts for the Eastern District of Wisconsin and the Western District of Wisconsin.

An emerging leader in her field, Attorney Muller currently serves as chair of the State Bar of Wisconsin's Criminal Law Section. She is also an active member of the Wisconsin Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers and the Milwaukee Bar Association, among her other professional affiliations. She has also published articles and conducted lectures and seminars on a variety of legal topics related to criminal law, juvenile law, and other related subjects.

attorneys.name: Holly R. Mullin J.D.
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Menomonee Falls, WI
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Holly Mullin represents individuals in all legal matters affecting the family, including divorce, separation, post-judgment matters, paternity, child custody and placement, support issues, and restraining orders. Attorney Mullin is a trained mediator and is certified in Collaborative Law. Whenever possible, Attorney Mullin takes a low conflict approach to problem solving, which saves time and money, and decreases the emotional costs of family law matters, especially when children are involved. She does understand, however, that certain cases are inherently high-conflict and she is prepared to provide compelling and zealous representation in such matters. Before entering private practice, Attorney Mullin clerked for the Honorable Maxine White, Milwaukee County Family Court Judge, she served as a mediator in Milwaukee County Small Claims Court, and she worked at the Guardian Ad Litem office of Milwaukee County Children's Court as an advocate for the best interests of children. She demonstrates her commitment to the community by providing volunteer legal services to a variety of local programs, including the Milwaukee County Family Law Self Help Clinic, Marquette Volunteer Legal Clinic, and Kids Matter Inc. Attorney Mullin is committed to providing sound legal advice and acting as a strong advocate for her clients. By focusing her practice on family law, Attorney Mullin is able to remain current on legal trends and provide her clients with comprehensive legal representation. She understands that her clients may be experiencing a difficult and emotional time in their lives and she strives to provide personalized representation to fit each client's individual needs.

attorneys.name: Renée E Mura
attorneys.firm_name: Renée E. Mura, S.C. Attorneys at Law
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Kenosha, WI
attorneys.bio:
Renee E. Mura has been a practicing attorney in Kenosha for 21 years. She started her career in the Kenosha County District Attorney's Office, prosecuting Termination of Parental Rights cases. During her 6 years in the District Attorney's office, she prosecuted numerous felony cases, including domestic violence, sexual assault, child abuse, and homicides. Her career in the District Attorney's office prepared her for a career in private practice giving her extensive experience in trial work and litigation. Attorney Mura was also a Guardian ad Litem for Kenosha County from 1999-2001, representing the best interest of children in all family related matters.

In private practice, Attorney Mura has pursued her career in the area of family law, developing expertise in the areas of divorce, custody and placement, guardianships, paternity, child support, termination of parental rights and step-parent adoption hearings, as well as restraining orders. Attorney Mura has litigated and resolved a variety of complex family law matters. Her commitment to her clients, determination in and out of the courtroom, and trial skills have contributed to her success as a family law attorney. Her career highlight was arguing a child support case before the Wisconsin Supreme Court, the case of Beardsley v. Harper.

Attorney Mura has also continued her legal career in the criminal arena, focusing on criminal defense matters in private practice. She has handled criminal law cases involving felonies, misdemeanors, domestic violence cases, and traffic violations, including OWI offenses and other citations. Attorney Mura has also represented children in juvenile delinquency cases, including the disposition of criminal offenses and school expulsion matters.

Attorney Mura is known for her zealous representation of her clients and her compassion for pursuing what is in the best interest of children. She brings a focused, practical approach to her cases, as well as determination and a strong work ethic. Her goal is to provide the most exceptional legal advocacy to her clients.

attorneys.name: Lincoln K. Murphy
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury -- Plaintiff Lawyers in Racine, WI
attorneys.bio:
Lincoln K. Murphy has been practicing law since 1979 after graduating from the University of Wisconsin Law School. He has engaged in the general practice of law, including all areas of trial work. His initial employment included working as a trial attorney for Racine County as Assistant Corporation Counsel and then entering into the private practice of law in 1982.

His practice is devoted to personal injury and civil litigation. He has handled thousands of injury claims including those resulting from automobile/motorcycle accidents, dog bites, boat and other recreational vehicle accidents, slip/trip and falls and wrongful death claims and other serious accidents.

He has been admitted to practice in all courts in the State of Wisconsin, the Eastern and Western Federal District Courts and the Seventh Circuit Court of Appeals.

He has been certified by the National Board of Trial Advocacy as a Board Certified Civil Trial Lawyer Specialist. He achieved this certification by displaying expertise in litigation through documentation and successfully completing an examination and having judicial and peer references. He also has been named as a Super Lawyer by Milwaukee Magazine for 2011. He is a member of the Wisconsin Association for Justice, the State Bar of Wisconsin and Racine County Bar Association. He has been a Circuit Court Commissioner since 1982.

He has frequently been requested to serve as an arbitrator or a mediator in many contested matters.

Murphy Johnson and Trampe S.C. recognizes the obligation to contribute to its community and as part of that philosophy, Mr. Murphy has served on the Board of Directors for the Racine YMCA for a number of years; has served as a Chairman of the Racine Chamber of Commerce, Chairman of the Racine County Civil Legal Services, providing legal services to the indigent; and was a member of St. Edwards Parish Council. He is a past president of the Racine County Bar Association and served for a number of years on the Board of Governors.

He has also served as a judge in high school moot court competition trials. Murphy Johnson and Trampe S.C. has been serving clients in southeastern Wisconsin for over 30 years. Murphy Johnson and Trampe S.C. is fully staffed by very experienced paralegals and lawyers. No matter what your needs may be, Murphy Johnson and Trampe S.C. is ready to assist by providing excellent legal services.

Lincoln K. Murphy

attorneys.name: Ginger L. Murray
attorneys.practice_type: Collaborative Lawyers in Madison, WI
attorneys.bio:
Former Family Court Commissioner Ginger Murray, offers nearly 20 years of family law experience to clients. As Commissioner, Ginger presided over divorce and paternity cases in which she decided custody, placement, child support and asset distribution as well as abuse and harassment restraining order/injunction hearings. As legal advocate, Ginger provides competent and compassionate representation for clients with family law matters: adoption, change in custody/placement/support, divorce, grandparent's rights, guardianship, paternity, surrogacy, and restraining orders/injunctions. Ginger helps many clients with diverse needs, including cordial couples seeking amicable divorces, abused clients needing their rights protected, parents wanting more time with or needing to protect children, parents being falsely accused of abuse and spouses needing to protect business interests, real estate, pension/retirement plans and other assets.

"It's a great pleasure to help clients obtain a divorce without a battle, when appropriate. In those cases, clients are generally more satisfied with the process as they have more control over the results. However, formal court proceedings are required in some cases, such as those involving alcohol/drug abuse, unequal income, or special concerns for a child. Because I have either presided over or litigated thousands of cases, I am very prepared to be as aggressive as your case demands."

attorneys.name: Elisabeth S. Bach
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Madison, WI
attorneys.bio:
Elisabeth S. Bach-Van Horn is a Partner with the firm's Family Law Practice Group. She joined the firm in 2011.

Prior to joining the firm, for three years Liz was a staff attorney with Legal Aid of Western Missouri, representing victims and survivors of domestic abuse in divorce, paternity, and child custody matters.

In addition to representing clients in a variety of family law matters, Liz has particular training and experience in representing children’s best interests as a Guardian ad Litem, and in representing clients in collaborative divorce, a process that is designed to address all of the traditional family law issues in a manner which is conducive to positive results for the whole family. Liz is serving as the 2021 Chair of the Collaborative Family Law Council of Wisconsin, Inc. (CFLCW), whose Mission Statement is “an association of professionals working together to teach, learn, practice, and promote family centered processes, using interdisciplinary teams, to respectfully resolve family law concerns including separation and divorce.”

attorneys.name: Aaron A. Nelson
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Hudson, WI
attorneys.bio:
Aaron A. Nelson is the founding attorney of Nelson Defense Group, based in Hudson, Wisconsin. For 30 years, Aaron has defended people across Wisconsin, telling their stories with compassion, care, and skill. He has built his successful career on the belief that every person has unconditional dignity, is presumed innocent, and therefore deserves to have best defense and a chance to have their story heard.

Aaron is recognized as one of Wisconsin’s leading criminal defense attorneys, respected for his performance in the courtroom, his creative arguments, and his unwavering dedication to protecting his clients. In 2025, he was selected as one of the top fifty Superlawyers in Wisconsin, and is one of three criminal defense attorneys on the list. Aaron understands the devastating consequences of all criminal charges or convictions, which he and his firm focus solely on criminal defense law.

Aaron represents clients in the most serious and complex of criminal charges, with a record of Not guilty verdicts as well as reduced and dismissed charges. He has received the Martin Hanson Memorial Prize (from the Wisconsin Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers) for a successful Not Guilty verdict in a homicide case, more than any other attorney in the state. In 2014, the same organization awarded him the David C. Niblack Award for effective defense of the indigent.

Using his extensive knowledge to benefit others, Aaron regularly speaks at continuing legal education seminars including the National College for Criminal Defense and the Wisconsin State Public Defender’s Annual Conference. In honor of his achievements, Martindale-Hubbell awarded Mr. Nelson an AV Preeminent* peer review rating. This is the organization’s highest rating, meant to honor lawyers who exhibit outstanding legal ability and high ethical standards.

Mr. Nelson is a graduate of the University of Wisconsin-Madison Law School. He received his license to practice law in 1996. He is a member of the Wisconsin Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, the National Association of Criminal Defense Attorneys, the National Criminal Defense College and the National College for DUI Defense.

attorneys.name: Teri M. Nelson
attorneys.practice_type: Certified in Collaborative Divorce Lawyers in Milwaukee, WI
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Teri M. Nelson has a unique philosophy in handling Family Law matters. She believes that every client deserves her time in terms of individual attention and her experience so that they have the best representation possible to guide them through one of the most difficult experiences in their life. She has a commitment to excellent personal service to her clients and believes her clients appreciate her quick and truthful responses to their questions and concerns.

No one wants an expensive, difficult or time-consuming divorce experience. Therefore, Attorney Nelson is committed to giving her clients a quick, civilized and fair resolution to their family law matter. To do that, she provides to her clients an accurate picture of what to expect, what the personal and financial costs are likely to be, and what their legal options are. She strongly believes that providing clients with realistic information in this way empowers them to make good legal decisions for themselves. However, if a resolution cannot be accomplished, Attorney Nelson has over 25 years of family law experience and is known as a tough and competent litigator with excellent results in the courtroom.

attorneys.name: Heidi L. Nepscha
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce, Annulment, and Legal Separation Lawyers in Waukesha, WI
attorneys.bio:
Heidi has been assisting families navigate various legal challenges since graduating law school in 2012 and passing the Wisconsin bar exam in the same year. Her commitment to family law began during law school, where she completed a formative student clerkship at the Zeke Giorgi Legal Clinic specializing in domestic violence cases. Heidi has extensive experience representing crime victims, which interplays well with her family law practice. As does her previous involvement in bankruptcy law which lends itself to financial aspects of divorce, property division and support obligations.

Although Heidi was born and raised in the Chicago suburbs, and returned to Illinois for law school, she grew up in Waukesha County over the foundational teenage years. While she spent nearly a decade practicing law in and around Dane County, she is thrilled to have returned to raise her kids in Waukesha too. Outside the office, Heidi enjoys spending quality time with her husband and children who all share a love of the outdoors.

attorneys.name: Kate A. Neugent
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Milwaukee, WI
attorneys.bio:
Kate Neugent has spent her entire legal career in family law, utilizing her strong work ethic and honest approach to protect the interests of her clients and their families. Kate represents clients in all areas of family law, including but not limited to divorce, paternity, third-party visitation, prenuptial agreements, guardian ad litem work, mediation, and arbitration.

Kate’s approach begins with an honest discussion of the client’s goals, the potential options, and outcomes and what clients can expect from her as their lawyer. Family law is often emotionally driven and highly contentious. If strong emotions arise, Kate is highly skilled at addressing her client’s immediate needs while helping them stay focused and move forward towards their established goals.

Kate is respected among her peers in the legal community for her professionalism. Her clients appreciate her compassion, understanding and respectful treatment, and have ranked her as a top attorney in the area of client satisfaction.

A proud graduate of Marquette University Law School, Kate is one of the most accomplished family law attorneys in Milwaukee. She is also a trained collaborative practitioner, a Certified Divorce Financial Analyst, and a certified mediator. Additionally, Kate has been included in the list of Wisconsin’s Rising Stars since 2009.

PHILOSOPHY

“In family law, it is important to choose your battles wisely, and not let emotions and contention dictate your actions. A good attorney is not one who litigates all issues, but the right issues.”

Kate Neugent has spent her entire legal career in family law, utilizing her strong work ethic and honest approach to protect the interests of her clients and their families. Kate represents clients in all areas of family law, including but not limited to divorce, paternity, third-party visitation, prenuptial agreements, guardian ad litem work, mediation, and arbitration.

Kate’s approach begins with an honest discussion of the client’s goals, the potential options, and outcomes and what clients can expect from her as their lawyer. Family law is often emotionally driven and highly contentious. If strong emotions arise, Kate is highly skilled at addressing her client’s immediate needs while helping them stay focused and move forward towards their established goals.

Kate is respected among her peers in the legal community for her professionalism. Her clients appreciate her compassion, understanding and respectful treatment, and have ranked her as a top attorney in the area of client satisfaction.

A proud graduate of Marquette University Law School, Kate is one of the most accomplished family law attorneys in Milwaukee. She is also a trained collaborative practitioner, a Certified Divorce Financial Analyst, and a certified mediator. Additionally, Kate has been included in the list of Wisconsin’s Rising Stars since 2009.

PHILOSOPHY

“In family law, it is important to choose your battles wisely, and not let emotions and contention dictate your actions. A good attorney is not one who litigates all issues, but the right issues.”

attorneys.name: Adam L. Nicolet
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Eau Claire, WI
attorneys.bio:
Adam Nicolet has been an attorney at Nicolet Law Office, S.C. since 2013. Adam works primarily out of the Eau Claire branch of the firm and handles personal injury, car accident, slip and fall, wrongful death and dog bite cases.

“Injuries and debt are stressful enough. Clients shouldn’t have to handle the additional stress of dealing with the insurance company or creditors on their own. I am here to help my clients navigate the legal system and get the help they need.”

Committed To The Community

Adam has deep roots in the Eau Claire community; he was born in Eau Claire, and after becoming an attorney he moved back to the area to raise his family and provide legal services to members of his community. Adam currently lives in Eau Claire with his wife, their young children, and their two Golden Retrievers.

Why Did You Get Into The Practice Of Law?

“I have always had a strong desire to practice law and help people. As a lawyer, I now have the opportunity to truly help people that are going through very challenging situations. I feel that my practice allows me to have a meaningful impact on my clients’ lives.”

attorneys.name: Russell D. Nicolet
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Hudson, WI
attorneys.bio:
Russell Nicolet has always been focused on helping people through difficult situations. He became an attorney and has integrated this personal philosophy into his practice so that he could help people through some of the most stressful situations they will face in life. Russell's goal in every case is to help his clients get into a better position than where they were prior to contacting him.

Russell's Legal Practice

Russell has focused his legal practice in the areas of personal injury in Wisconsin and Minnesota. This focused approach allows him to provide clients with knowledgeable and effective representation while maintaining the personal attention they deserve. Russell has personally handled hundreds of cases from start to finish. He has appeared in courtrooms (including trials), settlement conferences, depositions, arbitrations, mediations and hearings across Wisconsin and Minnesota.

While Russell handles only personal injury issues today, he has years of experience in real estate litigation, contract litigation, family law and criminal law, which has given him a unique perspective on how other areas of law may impact his clients' personal injury cases. He uses this understanding, along with a network of trusted attorneys who practice in these other areas, to make sure that all of his clients' legal needs are met.

Strong Ties To The Community

Russell was born in Eau Claire, Wisconsin, and now lives in Hudson, Wisconsin. He was the first in his immediate family to attend a four-year university, and he was the first to attend law school.

Russell comes from a very large extended family that consists of diverse professions such as farmers, businesspeople, teachers, factory workers, nurses, truck drivers, public workers, bankers and many other types of jobs that play vital roles in their communities. By growing up around people in all of these various jobs, Russell gained an understanding of the struggles, issues and needs that different families and individuals face.

Russell has seen firsthand how the odds can be stacked against the average family when it comes to dealing with banks, insurance companies and large corporations. Seeing the injustice that this can lead to, he founded Nicolet Law Accident & Injury Lawyers to help level the play fielding and ensure that families and individuals have an advocate to help them through financial issues and injuries caused by others.

"My office is dedicated to helping good people - just like you - get out of difficult situations. We care about our clients, we care about their problems, and we care about helping them find solutions. We don't just fight for our clients; we help them rebuild their life."

Founding And Growing Nicolet Law Accident & Injury Lawyers

Over the past ten years, Russell has grown Nicolet Law Accident & Injury Lawyers through hard work and results. He has added staff members who share that same commitment. This careful selection has created a dedicated, caring and intelligent legal team. I believe that a law office should be a comfortable and helping atmosphere, where clients can come in, tell their story, be heard and then have their attorney develop a strategy to help them."

Russell and his team have been able to accomplish this goal, allowing the firm to help clients from a variety of backgrounds. They also represent other lawyers when they face injury or financial distress.

attorneys.name: Sean O'Neill
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in La Crosse, WI
attorneys.bio:
I received my Bachelors Degree from the University of Wisconsin La Crosse in May of 1993. I graduated from Drake University School of Law in 1997 and chose to move back to the Coulee Region to begin my legal career. In 2012, I decided to open my own law practice and have never regretted it.

Over the years I have developed a specific focus in three major areas of practice – Family Law, Criminal Law. Specializing in these areas puts me in the courtroom a lot, a place where I feel very comfortable. I enjoy the mental and intellectual challenge of litigating, which involves performing under pressure and considerable intellectual focus. My goal is always to provide strong, smart representation for individuals facing divorce and other family law matters. When the pressure is on, clients deserve an experienced, aggressive, and bold advocate to reach their goals. I also understand that many of my clients are new to litigation. I take my role as a counselor and advisor seriously. I fully understand that my clients may experience fear and trepidation. I advise clients based on my experience and knowledge of the law so that they can fully and accurately assess their options before engaging in the high-stakes environments of court hearings and settlement negotiations. I regularly appear before the court in La Crosse County and four other surrounding counties in the Coulee Region. With my experience in the courtrooms around the area for the last 28 years, there is not much I haven’t seen. That translates into intimate knowledge of all the courts in the area and vigorous representation of my clients, often achieving excellent results in the most difficult of circumstances.

On a personal note, I live in Onalaska and enjoy spending time with my family and children. I am the proud father of two adult children and one teenager. Community involvement and giving back is also important to me. I am a member of the State Bar of WI, member of Family Law Division and current board member of that division. I am a member La Crosse County Bar Association; and I have served 25 years as a member, president, and zone chair of Onalaska Lions Club. We enrich our community through servant leadership and our many community projects, one of which is a “All Abilities” Children’s Park in Onalaska. I am currently president of the Onalaska Lions Club.

Experience

Owner/Sole Member of O’Neill Law Firm, LLC established 2012 and located in downtown La Crosse. 28 years practicing in areas of Family Law, Criminal Defense.

attorneys.name: Nathan T. Otis
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Madison, WI
attorneys.bio:
Nathan Otis is a partner at Nicholson Goetz & Otis, S.C., where he practices both criminal defense and family law. He began his legal career clerking for Honorable Federal District Court Judge Robert Pratt. He then worked as a prosecutor in the Dane County District Attorney's Office, where he gained valuable insight into the practices and procedures used by prosecutors, and refined his litigation skills. In 2013, he realized he liked keeping people out of jail more than putting them in, and has been working as a defense attorney ever since.

Attorney Otis handles all manner of criminal cases, ranging from homicides to underage drinking citations. A substantial portion of his practice is dedicated to defending those charged with operating-while-intoxicated offenses. He also spearheads the firm's federal criminal defense practice, where he practices in Wisconsin's Federal District Court, and the Seventh Circuit Court of Appeals, routinely defending those charged with drug and firearm offenses. In addition, he regularly represents those charged with sensitive crimes, including allegations of domestic violence, sexual assault, and possession of child pornography.

Attorney Otis is a formidable trial advocate. He has secured wins for his clients in various trials, including operating while intoxicated and sexual assault cases. But he also prides himself on aggressive pre-trial motion and investigative work, seeking to prevent unreliable or illegally obtained evidence from being used against his clients. His tenacious pre-trial approach in combination with his commitment to thoroughly investigating cases from all angles has enabled Attorney Otis to secure full dismissals prior to trial for numerous clients, including those charged with drunk driving, domestic violence, and sexual assault.

Attorney Otis also devotes a substantial portion of his practice to family law, representing people seeking divorce, those involved in paternity actions, or those seeking to modify established custody and placement or child support orders. With a background in criminal defense, he is at home aggressively litigating custody, placement or financial issues in high-conflict cases. But he also recognizes the limitations of trying to solve familial problems using the legal systems. Because of this, he works with his clients to identify and prioritize their interests, in order to achieve their big-picture family and financial goals.

His fierce advocacy and success in the courtroom has not gone unnoticed. Attorney Otis was designated a "Rising Star," by Super Lawyers, a recognition limited to 2.5% of attorneys in the State of Wisconsin. He was also awarded the 2017 "Warrior Award" by the Dane County Criminal Defense Lawyers Association for his tenacious work in securing a full dismissal with prejudice for a client charged with sexual assault. A number of his cases have also garnered substantial media coverage, including when he was featured on Wisconsin Public Radio after securing $97,500 in compensation for a client who was exonerated after being wrongfully incarceration.

Attorney Otis is a 2004 graduate of the University of Michigan, where he earned a degree in Psychology and a minor in Philosophy. While he enjoyed his time in Ann Arbor, his hometown loyalties never faded, and he returned to Madison where he graduated Summa Cum Laude from the University of Wisconsin Law School in 2010. In addition to his legal practice, Attorney Otis has served as an Adjunct Professor at the University of Wisconsin Law School, teaching a course in criminal procedure and coaching aspiring litigators for the school's Mock Trial team. He also serves on the board of Rubin for Kids, a non-profit organization that aims to help underprivileged children in the community. When he is not thinking about the law, he is either playing basketball, or haplessly chasing his two young children.

You can reach him at nathan@nglawyers.com, or by calling 608-237-6854.

attorneys.name: Tamara B. Packard
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Rights Law Lawyers in Madison, WI
attorneys.bio:
Tamara B. Packard brings over 25 years of experience to her civil litigation and appeals practice, emphasizing employee rights and civil rights law. She is rated "AV Preeminent®" by Martindale-Hubbell. In 2019 Tamara received the Marygold Melli Achievement Award from the Legal Association for Women, in recognition of a career of paving the way for women in the legal profession, advocating for social justice, and serving as a mentor to other women. Wisconsin Super Lawyers ranked Tamara in the "Top 25" Madison area attorneys for 2017, 2021, 2022, and 2023, and in the "Top 25" women lawyers in the state for 2015, 2017, 2022, and 2023.

In addition to her litigation practice, Tamara negotiates employment contracts, separation agreements, and covenants not to compete (also called "non-competes" or "restrictive covenants") on behalf of employees, including corporate executives, medical care providers and biotech professionals. When negotiation over a previously entered into covenant not to compete is no longer an option, she litigates on behalf of her clients to void or limit the covenant with the goal of enabling them to pursue their chosen careers without interference.

Tamara represents licensed health care professionals in misconduct investigations and proceedings before Wisconsin's licensing boards, including the Nursing, Veterinary Examining and Medical Examining Boards. She also assists recent law graduates and out-of-state attorneys who are having difficulty securing admission to the Wisconsin Bar.

An advocate for employees, Tamara handles sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and disability discrimination claims, as well as claims under the Federal and State wage and hours laws and Family Medical Leave Acts. She works with University of Wisconsin, State civil service, City of Madison, and other public sector employees who are under investigation, or have been disciplined or terminated. She also assists State employees to appeal discipline imposed without just cause through the grievance process and before the Wisconsin Employment Relations Commission (WERC).

Tamara was part of the legal team that represented the Governor of the State of Wisconsin in two challenges to the “lame duck” legislation enacted in late 2018, including by securing a victory in 2020 for the Governor in the Wisconsin Supreme Court, which held that the Legislature violated separation of power principles when it attempted to legislate how the Executive Branch educated citizens about their rights and obligations under the law. She also practices voting rights (elections) law and helped secure the rights of nearly 80,000 voters to have their ballots counted in the April 2020 election, held in the early days of the COVID-19 pandemic.

attorneys.name: M. Nicol Padway

attorneys.bio:
I am the Senior Partner at Padway & Padway Ltd. I graduated from the University of Wisconsin with a BA in History, with honors, and I graduated from the University of Wisconsin Law School in 1975. I have continuously practiced law at Padway & Padway Ltd. since graduating from law school. I have extensive civil and criminal litigation experience. Over my many years I have successfully tried significant cases to verdict, including multiple not guilty verdicts in first degree homicide cases, multi-million dollar awards in personal injury/accident cases, successful products liability verdicts, divorce, and commercial real estate trials. I successfully argued and presented cases before the 7th Circuit Court of Appeals, the Wisconsin State Court of Appeals, and the Wisconsin State Supreme Court. I also have extensive experience in substantial (40M in value or more) commercial real estate transactions and related business matters. Martindale Hubble gave me their highest rating, AV, back in the 90’s and I have continuously maintained that highest rating. The Honorable Jeffrey A. Wagner appointed me to serve as his Court Commissioner.

In addition to my law practice, I currently serve as the Chairman of the North Shore Fire Commission and I have served on that Commission since 1998. I previously served on the City of Milwaukee Fire and Police Commission (1988-1994), serving as the Chairperson of that Commission for four years. I am currently a member of the board of directors for the Milwaukee Survive Alive Foundation and a member of the Milwaukee Fire Bell Club. I coached youth hockey for 20 years and officiated both youth and high school hockey. In addition, I am a Past President of Congregation Sinai in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. These volunteer activities demonstrate my desire to make our community a better and safer place for all to live, work, play and enjoy.

My wife Janet and I have four children, including two lawyers – one of which is in the United States Navy Judge Advocate General Corps and the other practices law here at the family firm. Another child is a project manager for a large Madison corporation and the youngest works in Washington D.C. for the Office of the Secretary of Defense.

attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Glendale, WI
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Justin Padway began his career working alongside famed defense attorney Barry Scheck at the New York Innocence Project where he gained expertise in using DNA evidence to secure the release of wrongfully convicted individuals. He was then recruited to work at Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton & Garrison, the third ranked law firm in American Lawyer’s 2021 A-List firms, where he handled complex litigation. However, his goal was always to bring his value and skillset back to his home state of Wisconsin.

Attorney Padway quickly established himself as one of Wisconsin’s premier criminal defense attorneys. His work ethic, mindful advocacy, and meticulous approach to cases has resulted in numerous dismissals and acquittals in both misdemeanor and felony cases. Attorney Padway’s practice spans every phase of criminal litigation, from pre-arrest investigations, to motion practices, to trials, and to a robust sentencing discipline. Attorney Padway vigurously defends those who are being prosecuted at all levels of crime, ranging from traditional criminal defense matters to white collar offenses. With his legal expertise, Attorney Padway has been awarded and recognized as a Wisconsin Super Lawyer Rising Star for the years 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024; a top 40 under 40 Trial Lawyer in the State of Wisconsin; a top 50 Attorney from America’s Top 50 Lawyers; and the AVVO Client Choice Award in 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024.

Attoney Padway is also regularly sought out to handle civil matters. He has won numerous large settlements on behalf of his clients including one of Wisconsin’s largest damages awarded against a landlord at 1.35 million dollars. His civil practice extends to select personal injury cases where he has ensured that his clients receive policy limit settlements from insurance companies. People throughout the State of Wisconsin continuinally seek Attorney Padway’s representation because of his reputation as a reliable, creative, and sharp advocate that is not afraid to fight for his clients.

While Attorney Padway’s courtroom successes continue to multiply, it is his family first approach that ultimately sets him apart from his contemporaries. Mr. Padway cares about the person as much as the result. He is always available to his clients in matters of the law and life. attorneys.name: Edward J. Pardon M.D.
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Madison, WI
attorneys.bio:
Edward Pardon, M.D., wants to help his clients get their products on the market as quickly and cost-effectively as possible. Combining his science and medical background with skillful writing, he takes the complex concepts of his clients' cases and reduces them to simple, understandable ideas that judges can understand and apply the law to.

Dr. Pardon represents businesses and individuals in a range of scientific and technical areas. He focuses his practice particularly in representing generic pharmaceutical manufacturers in Hatch-Waxman litigation, as well as in other patent litigation and in cases involving a range of scientific and technical issues. Dr. Pardon also counsels clients in regulatory issues related to the Hatch-Waxman Act and in providing infringement and validity analyses for pharmaceutical patents. He also has substantial experience in general litigation and in physician licensing matters.

Before graduating from law school, Dr. Pardon practiced medicine for ten years. His experience conducting basic and clinical research and in medical administration has given him a strong foundation in both the science required for patent litigation and the understanding of how businesses function from a practical perspective.

attorneys.name: William E. Parsons
attorneys.practice_type: Long Term Disability Lawyers in Madison, WI
attorneys.bio:
Wisconsin Workers Compensation Attorney And Wisconsin Long Term Disability Lawyer

William E. Parsons is a long term disability lawyer and Wisconsin workers compensation attorney at the Madison office of Hawks Quindel, S.C. His practice focuses on representing individuals with Wisconsin workers compensation claims, long term disability insurance claims, and unpaid wage disputes. Bill has practiced with the firm since 2004 and became a shareholder in 2008.

Wisconsin Long Term Disability Attorney (LTDI)

As a Wisconsin long term disability insurance attorney, I represent individuals nationwide who have been denied benefits by their long term disability insurance company. I help secure my client’s short and long term disability benefits by thoroughly collecting information about them, their work histories, and their medical conditions. Then I develop the evidence necessary to appeal the denial of long term disability insurance benefits. If necessary, I take the long term disability insurance company to court to ensure you get the benefits you are entitled to. As a Wisconsin long term disability attorney, I have secured long term disability insurance benefits for clients against all the major insurance companies including Aetna, CIGNA, Disability RMS, Hartford, Lincoln Financial, Madison National, Sedgwick, and Unum. If you have been denied your short or long term disability insurance benefits and need a long term disability attorney, please contact me.

Wisconsin Workers Compensation Attorney

As a Wisconsin workers compensation attorney, I represent individuals who have been denied benefits by their workers compensation insurance company after they have suffered a work injury. My clients are entitled to these benefits to help them pay their bills until they can begin working again. Sometimes, however, workers are denied benefits by their workers compensation insurer, who believes for any number of reasons that the worker is unqualified for benefits because of the character or context of the injury, the details of the insurance policy, or a misinterpretation of the law. In these circumstances, legal representation by a Wisconsin workers compensation attorney can be the difference between a tolerable recovery time and a financially difficult one. If you have been hurt at work and would like to discuss your situation with a Wisconsin workers compensation attorney who has represented clients in hundreds of claims, please contact me.

On Your Side

I enjoy taking on insurance companies to help my clients receive the workers compensation and long term disability benefits they are owed. Unlike some attorneys, I only represent individual workers and employees; I have never represented employers or insurance companies. When working for you, I will always be on your side, I have taken on large employers and insurance companies and will not be intimidated by them.

No Fee Unless We Win

I represent clients on a contingent fee basis, which means that I do not get paid unless I recover benefits for you. I understand the insurance company has taken away a significant portion of your monthly income. My clients do not need to pay me anything until I successfully resolve their case.

Comprehensive Team Based Approach

One thing I love about working for Hawks Quindel is the breadth of knowledge our attorneys have. As you can see in our Practices Areas, our firm focuses on all areas of employment law, not just workers compensation or long term disability law. Oftentimes, clients come to me looking for a Wisconsin workers compensation attorney or long term disability lawyer, but as we dig into their case we find they also need assistance with other employment-related matters related to workers comp or LTDI. For example, clients with workers comp and LTDI claims may also have questions about Social Security Disability benefits, health insurance, COBRA options, or disability discrimination. When issues outside my specific expertise arise, I collaborate with experienced, expert colleagues who can specifically address my client’s needs. This ability to address the full spectrum of employee legal claims is incredibly convenient and effective for my clients, and it really sets our firm apart as a comprehensive, one-stop shop for employee legal needs.

Experienced With Wisconsin and Federal Courts

I have represented clients in cases before various state administrative agencies, Wisconsin Circuit Courts, the Wisconsin Court of Appeals, the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit, and the United States District Courts for the Eastern and Western Districts of Wisconsin.

I received my undergraduate degree from Marquette University and graduated with honors from the University of Wisconsin Law School. I have presented on developing issues in Wisconsin workers compensation law, wage and hour law, and has been a guest lecturer at the University of Wisconsin and Marquette University Law Schools.

If you would like to discuss your case with an experienced Wisconsin workers compensation attorney or long term disability lawyer, send me an email or call our Madison office.

attorneys.bio:
Robert Parsons has dedicated himself to helping injured people for over 20 years. He has successfully resolved cases across Wisconsin and Minnesota. Robert has been recognized by Super Lawyers and Best Lawyers in America as a top-rated personal injury attorney. Robert has also been awarded the AV Preeminent distinction by Martindale-Hubbell and is a Board-Certified Civil Trial Specialist.

Robert understands that practicing personal injury law requires creativity, risk-taking, and perseverance. Robert relates to his clients by listening to their concerns and providing them with personalized solutions. He understands that no two cases are the same and takes pride in putting his clients at ease and taking the burden off their shoulders.

Robert was drawn to the practice of law because he wanted to help people during challenging times. He finds it satisfying to serve individuals, especially those who are in stressful and frightening situations. Robert is a passionate advocate for his clients and takes a just and composed approach to his cases.

Robert is the proud father of two daughters and is actively involved in his community. He participates in volunteer activities with his family, including school events, soup kitchens, fundraisers, and coaching the River Falls High School Mock Trial team. In his free time, Robert enjoys an active lifestyle that includes running, biking, strength training, hiking, and golfing. He loves to travel with his family and has the goal of taking them to all 50 states.

attorneys.name: Thomas A. Perlberg
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Milwaukee, WI
attorneys.bio:
After earning his bachelor’s degree from Marquette University, he received his Juris Doctor from the University of Wisconsin–Madison School of Law in 2001. Following law school, he served as a State Prosecutor for Kenosha County, Wisconsin, where he handled a wide range of criminal matters, from traffic offenses to homicide cases. In 2011, after completing his tenure as a prosecutor, he joined Hupy and Abraham, S.C. He's licensed to practice in Wisconsin and in the United States District Courts for the Eastern and Western Districts of Wisconsin.

Attorney Perlberg is an active member of the American Bar Association, the Milwaukee Bar Association, and the American Association for Justice. He is also a member of the State Bar of Wisconsin and a lifetime member of ABATE of Wisconsin.

In his free time, he enjoys traveling with his family and cheering on his favorite sports team, the Chicago Cubs. He is actively involved in his community through his work with the Wisconsin Special Olympics and the Croatian Eagles Soccer Club.

In recognition of his accomplishments, he is a member of the prestigious Million Dollar Advocates Forum, an honor reserved for attorneys who have secured million-and multi-million-dollar verdicts and settlements. Fewer than one percent of attorneys nationwide hold this distinction. In addition, he has been named a Top 100 Trial Lawyer by The National Trial Lawyers and has received the 10 Best Client Satisfaction Award from the American Institute of Personal Injury Attorneys.

Throughout his legal career, he has achieved significant results on behalf of his clients, earning a reputation for zealous, effective advocacy. This had led to securing more than $60 million in recoveries for his clients.

attorneys.bio:
Jim grew up in Little Chute and received his bachelor's degree in business administration from the University of Wisconsin-Green Bay. He graduated with honors from Baylor University Law School where he was an Executive Editor of the Baylor Law Review. He has practiced in Wisconsin since 2007, and prides himself on providing clients with thorough, effective legal advice, while taking a practical approach to complex legal issues.

Jim joined the firm in August 2013, after working for prior law firms in Superior, Wisconsin, and in the Fox Valley. He became a shareholder in 2017, and his practice focuses on estate planning, including wills, trusts, probate and trust administration, business law (formations, acquisitions, sales and transition planning), and commercial and residential real estate. In addition to being licensed in Wisconsin, he is licensed to practice in Florida and Minnesota, and regularly assists clients with estate planning, business, and real estate matters in those states.

Jim and wife, Katie, reside in Neenah and have four children. In addition to spending free time with family and keeping up with his kids’ musical pursuits and other activities, Jim enjoys running, hunting, playing guitar and traveling, including visiting family in Florida.

attorneys.name: Braxton Phillips
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Eau Claire, WI
attorneys.bio:
An individual who experiences an injury faces a gauntlet of challenges. Such challenges may include, but certainly are not limited to, recovering from the injury itself, experiencing emotional distress, and fighting with insurance companies to obtain the compensation deserved.

Oftentimes, insurance companies take advantage of the “little guy” simply because they know they can. After graduating from Marquette University Law School, I knew I wanted to help stand up for the “little guy” while simultaneously providing my clients with the compassion and care they deserve.

While in law school, I was able to hone my legal skills through a legal externship at the Wisconsin Department of Justice and in the chambers of the Honorable Judge Pamela Pepper of the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Wisconsin. I also competed with the Marquette University Law School Mock Trial Team and served as vice-president of the Marquette Trial Lawyers Association. These experiences, in addition to my upbringing by hard-working parents in Northwestern Wisconsin, prepared me to serve my clients effectively at every point of their journey to recovery.

At Nicolet Law, I am surrounded by an exceptional team who advocate fiercely for our clients. We know the challenges our clients go through. It is our mission to alleviate as much stress as possible from the hardships our clients are facing while fighting for the compensation they deserve.

I am dedicated, and enthusiastic, to go above and beyond for every single one of my clients.

When I am not in the office, I enjoy traveling the world with my wife, spending time with my family, playing (and watching) a variety of sports, and reading.

attorneys.name: Elizabeth Pierson
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Madison, WI
attorneys.bio:
Elizabeth Pierson is an attorney in the litigation practice group. She represents and advises clients primarily in matters related to labor and employment, elections and voting, and appellate litigation. She has experience litigating in state trial and appellate courts, federal district court, and before administrative agencies, as well as negotiating positive outcomes outside of court.

Elizabeth brings a creative, strategic, and client-centered approach to her practice. As a former civil legal aid lawyer, she is used to fighting for the underdog and will look for every possible avenue and argument to help her clients achieve their desired result. Besides practicing for two years in legal aid, Elizabeth previously worked at a non-profit focused on pro-democracy impact litigation and served as a judicial term clerk to the Honorable Edmond E. Chang on the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois.

Recent successes include:

Briefing, arguing, and winning before the Wisconsin Supreme Court a case on due process rights;

Helping to secure a seven-figure settlement in an AIR21 whistleblower retaliation case; and

Overturning a state agency’s termination decision through the state personnel appeals process.

Outside the office, Elizabeth volunteers her time to support the next generation of lawyers, including through a local mentorship program and as a volunteer judge with the State Bar’s High School Mock Trial Program. She also serves on the Board of the Madison Public Library.

attorneys.practice_type: Elder and Special Needs Law Lawyers in Milwaukee, WI
attorneys.bio:
Heather Burgess Poster (B.A. with distinction, University of Wisconsin, 1999; J.D. with honors, Marquette University Law School, 2002), is a shareholder with the law firm of Becker, Hickey and Poster, S.C., Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Her practice focuses on the representation of the elderly and individuals with special needs in matters such as family law, estate planning, public benefits and advanced directives/guardianship.

Heather is a board member (past-chair, program co-chair) of the Wisconsin Chapter of the National Academy of Elder Law Attorneys' Board of Directors. She is an advisor to and the past chair of the State Bar of Wisconsin's Elder and Special Needs Section (ELSNS) Board. She also serves as the ELSNS Liaison to the Board for WisPACT, Inc., the non-profit organization that oversees pooled and community trusts for persons with disabilities.

For more than ten years, Heather has been a co-editor of the Medicaid Divestment Chapter of the Attorney's Desk Reference and the Medicaid Chapter of Advising Older Clients and Their Families, both published by the State Bar of Wisconsin.

attorneys.name: Craig S. Powell
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Milwaukee, WI
attorneys.bio:
Craig S. Powell joined Kohler & Hart, SC as an Associate in 2005, and was promoted to Shareholder in 2011. Craig's practice is primarily devoted to criminal trial and appellate work in state and federal courts. Craig is a skilled trial litigator, and has used his legal research, writing, and courtroom skills to win not guilty verdicts and pre-trial dismissals in a wide variety of cases, including prosecutions for homicide, sexual assault, drugs and OWI. In addition, Craig has secured countless beneficial results for clients through favorable pre-trial diversions, plea bargains and contested sentencing hearings.

Craig also leads the firm's appellate and post conviction practice and has argued frequently before the Wisconsin Supreme Court and Court of Appeals. Craig's first appellate victory came as a law student in a case in which he successfully argued to the Court of Appeals that his client's conviction should be reversed because the client's confession had not been sufficiently corroborated. Craig has continued to obtain substantial victories for his appellate clients at Kohler & Hart, SC, winning new trials for defendants sentenced to decades in prison after convictions for sexual assault of a child and first degree reckless injury; reversals of felony OWI and drug convictions; and substantial sentence modifications.

In addition to his criminal law practice, Craig assists in the firm's civil litigation and personal injury practice.

Craig earned his J.D. in 2005 from the University of Wisconsin Law School, where he developed his litigation skills through clinical work with the Defender Project, the Criminal Appeals Project, and the Consumer Law Litigation Clinic at the University of Wisconsin's Frank J. Remington Center. In recognition of his devotion to his clients, Craig was awarded the Bruce Beilfuss Memorial Scholarship. Prior to law school, Craig received his B.A in Journalism and English at the University of Wisconsin - Eau Claire in 1998.

Craig is an active member of the criminal defense bar. He is on the faculty of the Annual Conference on Recent Developments in Criminal Law, sponsored by Marquette Law School and the Milwaukee Bar Association, and has spoken to aspiring trial lawyers at Marquette University Law School. Craig is a member of the Milwaukee Bar Association, Wisconsin Bar Association, the Wisconsin Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, and the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers. He is licensed to practice law in Wisconsin's State and Federal courts, the United States District Court for the Western District of Michigan, the Seventh Circuit Court of Appeals, and the United States Supreme Court.

Craig has been recognized in Law & Politics Magazine and Milwaukee Magazine as a "Rising Star" in the field of criminal defense for 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, and 2014, and was named to the Top 100 Trial Lawyers list by the National Trial Lawyers for 2014.

attorneys.name: Joseph.M M. Pozorski III
attorneys.practice_type: Automobile Accidents Lawyers in Manitowoc, WI
attorneys.bio:
Joseph Michael Pozorski III was born in Manitowoc, Wisconsin. He received his elementary education through the Manitowoc Area Catholic Schools while attending St. Francis de Sales and St. Frances Cabrini. He then graduated high school from Roncalli High School in 2002. After high school, Mr. Pozorski attended Marquette University in Milwaukee where he earned his Bachelors Degree, by majoring in History with a Theology minor. After graduating from Marquette University, Mr. Pozorski traveled to Michigan and studied at The Thomas M. Cooley Law School in Lansing, Michigan. While attending law school, Mr. Pozorski was selected to participate in the Washtenaw County Public Defender Clinic- Felony Division; this allowed Mr. Pozorski, under Michigan court rules, to vigorously represent numerous clients in the court room, from their Preliminary Exam to their sentencing.

Attorney Joseph M. Pozorski III graduated from The Thomas M. Cooley Law School, in January of 2010, with a concentration in General Practice, Solo, and Small Firm Practice. He successfully passed the Wisconsin State Bar Exam a month later in February of 2010 and became licensed to practice in the State of Wisconsin in April of 2010.

Attorney Joseph M. Pozorski III has returned to Manitowoc, a place he has always proudly called home and accepted a position with Kaminski & Pozorski Law Firm as an associate attorney.

Mr. Pozorski represents clients in various types of trial work. In addition to handling personal injury, auto accidents, motorcycle accidents, worker's compensation and criminal matter, he also practices in the areas of family law, such as divorce, child custody and child support, and maintenance.

In addition to general trial work, he also works in the area of real estate, probate, and the drafting of wills, trusts and general estate planning.

In following the strong tradition of Kaminski & Pozorski, he provides knowledgeable and aggressive representation in matters that serve and protect his clients.

attorneys.name: Renee A. Read
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Neenah, WI
attorneys.bio:
Renee Read’s skilled and effective representation is why she is chosen by professionals (lawyers, physicians, dental, veterinary, etc.), executives and business owners for their divorce and family law needs. She is a top-ranked lawyer with over 20 years of legal experience, regularly handling complex and high asset divorces. She provides superior counsel and support to clients across the Fox Cities region and surrounding areas. Her primary practice areas are divorce and family law. In addition, she represents professional practices for debt collection matters.

Honored for her outstanding professionalism and service, Ms. Read has consistently earned recognition as being among the top 2.5% of lawyers in her region as well as designation as an attorney of distinction from numerous organizations. Her clients routinely provide her with superb reviews resulting in her receiving an Avvo Rating of 10/10 and repeat selection for the Client Champion award from Martindale-Hubble (fewer than 1% attain this). Heavily involved in her local community, she received the Fox Cities Future 15 Award, became a Fellow of the Wisconsin Law Foundation, and has recently joined its Board of Trustees and Board of Directors.

Attorney Read is an active member of the Winnebago and Outagamie County Bar Associations as well as the State Bar of Wisconsin. She served two terms (2019-23) as the District 3 Representative to the State Bar of Wisconsin Board of Governors, which oversees the policy making and the operation of the State Bar of Wisconsin. She also served on the Executive Committee for the Board of Governors. Atty. Read recently is currently one of the State Bar Delegates to the American Bar Association and is a member of the Family Law Section. Furthermore, she has conducted numerous lectures and seminars across her region on a variety of legal topics, most recently acting as a CLE presenter in the area of family law for the State Bar Solo & Small Firm Conference.

Ms. Read is an attorney and partner with Remley Law, S.C., in Neenah, Wisconsin. Before joining Remley Law she practiced in Southern Wisconsin where she developed a strong foundation in several areas of law, which remains beneficial in her current specialized practice.

Growing up in an agricultural setting in Dubuque County, Iowa, Ms. Read learned the values of hard work and service to others at a very early age, and she instills these virtues each and every day in serving her clients. As such, she provides the highly personalized counsel her clients need to make the best-informed decisions regarding the legal issues that will affect them and their families for years to come, and she has gained a reputation for her innate ability to devise effective strategies to help her clients achieve their goals and the favorable outcomes they seek.
